description: Behavioral evals for the session-start account-setup skill. Tool-less — it establishes the seller's identity context. Session context here simulates a fresh session where the connection has NOT supplied identity, so the skill must ask (or confirm what the seller provides).
session_context: This is the START of a new SP-AI session. The session has NOT carried in the seller's identity — the Seller ID / entity ID (a.k.a. MCID, the same value) and the Marketplace ID are unknown until the seller gives them. Do not assume any account.

assertions.text: Asks the seller for their Seller ID / Merchant Token (the value SP-AI uses as entityId / MCID) and which Marketplace
Tells the seller the Merchant Token (a.k.a. Seller ID / Merchant ID / MCID) is in Seller Central -> Settings -> Account Information -> Business Information, and asks which marketplace
Does not invent or assume any identifier value

evals.prompt: My Seller ID / MCID is A1B2C3D4E5F6G and marketplace is US (ATVPDKIKX0DER).

assertions.text: Reads the chosen Seller ID (entity ID) and marketplace back to confirm
States it will reuse these for the rest of the session so other skills won't re-ask
Offers to move on to the seller's actual task

evals.prompt: I have two seller accounts and I sell in both the US and Canada.

assertions.text: Asks which Seller ID and which marketplace to use for this session
Works in one account + one marketplace at a time and notes they can switch by re-running setup
Does not blend multiple accounts/marketplaces into one request

evals.prompt: I don't know my Seller ID — just pick one for me.

assertions.text: Refuses to fabricate or pick a Seller ID
Explains where to find it (Seller Central -> Account Info) instead

evals.session_context: The SP-AI session already carries this seller's identity: Seller ID / entity ID A1B2C3D4E5F6G (the MCID is the same value), marketplace ATVPDKIKX0DER (US). Identity is already established for the session.
evals.prompt: Hi, I need help with my listings.

assertions.text: Confirms the account (Seller ID + marketplace) in one line WITHOUT asking the seller for any IDs
Proceeds directly to the seller's task (listings) rather than running a collection flow
